text:
Marco (infra): heads up — cost alert this morning, interactive sessions pinned 4 V100s in hot-pool for 3 hours and blocked async batch. AWS spot reclaim + manual keepalive caused huge churn :grimace:
Sam P.: ugh. do we have metrics on how often interactive holds hot GPUs vs using elastic pool? :eyes:
Marco (infra): rough numbers: 48% of hot-pool time last 24h from interactive notebooks, 32% from short inference jobs, 20% batch. Batch could be shifted but we need a safe plan for state+checkpoints.
Jaya R: we should separate tenancy: small guaranteed slice for interactive (low-latency), and a transient 'burst' tier for both batch and preemptible inference. Give batch a priority score and off-peak window.
Lina (sre): agree. proposal: maintain 6-GPU hot slice per region for interactive pinned workloads; everything else -> mixed-transient pool. Do aggressive eviction for idle kernels after 10m.
Marco (infra): eviction 10m sounds okay. Also want smarter preemption: prefer reclaim from burst instances with lowest reuse score. Can we implement weighted drain?
Sam P.: We could use a reclaim policy like: prefer spot with longest idle + lowest affinity. Also add a delay window to avoid oscillation.
Jaya R: interruption handling for batch: require jobs to register a checkpoint hook. minimal API: on SIGTERM -> upload checkpoint to /checkpoints/<job_id>. If no hook, controller will cancel and restart on next slot.
Lina (sre): adding controller-side wrapper makes this easier. Pseudocode config in case we want to roll quickly:
```
pool:
  name: mixed-transient
  capacity: 200 gpus
  tiers:
    - name: hot
      size: 6
      reserved_for: interactive
    - name: burst
      size: 120
      preemptible: true
    - name: batch-backfill
      size: 74
      schedule: "22:00-06:00 UTC"
eviction_policy:
  idle_timeout: 600
  prefer_reclaim: ["burst","batch-backfill"]
```
Sam P.: love it. Also add a ramp-down for batch start to avoid noisy neighbor spikes at 22:00. e.g. step up 10% every 5min.
Marco (infra): one more: network egress contention. When many batch jobs start at off-peak they saturate infra egress and cause timeouts for interactive. Need per-pool egress throttle or token bucket.
Lina (sre): will add per-pool egress shaping + per-tenant circuit breaker. Simple rate limit: 200MB/s for batch-backfill until warmup completes.
spot-monitor-bot: [automated] predicted spot interruption window for us-west-2: 1779051600-1779055200 (high) — recommend shift non-urgent runs.
Jaya R: thanks — let's tag any non-critical batch jobs with "flexible=true" so scheduler can migrate around predicted windows.
Sam P.: rollout plan: 1) config + controller wrapper in staging; 2) enable eviction + egress shaping in canary region; 3) enable scheduled batch window and monitoring; 4) full roll. 24-48h to canary?
Marco (infra): timeline sounds good. Lina, can you own the canary? I'll draft runbook for interruption and restart flow.
Lina (sre): taking it. I'll post a checklist in #eng-oncall when canary is live. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-4928 for mixed-transient pool rollout (assignees: Marco, Lina, Sam).
